presentation.summary: Scrobble movie and episode playback to a self-hosted Yamtrack instance.
presentation.description_markdown:
Sends live playback starts and completed stops to Yamtrack through its existing Jellyfin webhook. History import, progress sync, favorites, and watchlists are not included. Floppy users should install Silo's Floppy watch-provider plugin instead.

Community plugin by Silo (https://github.com/artifaxx/silo-plugin-yamtrack), built for Bloem on the Bloem plugin SDK.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install this plugin and enable it.
2. In Yamtrack, open **Account settings → Integrations** and copy the Jellyfin webhook URL.
3. In Silo, open **Settings → Watch Providers**, connect Yamtrack, and paste that URL.

Movies need TMDB or IMDb. Episodes need TVDB or IMDb; Yamtrack skips TMDB-only episodes.

If you run Floppy (the Yamtrack fork), install Silo's Floppy watch-provider plugin instead of this one.

capabilities.description: Scrobble playback to a self-hosted Yamtrack instance using its Jellyfin webhook URL.
